lines.en: label beachvacation2:
scene beachvactwo1
Ayane and Ami pull me over to the front of the women’s restroom as soon as we set foot on the beach.
lines.zh: 我们一踏上沙滩，Ayane和Ami就把我拉到了女洗手间门口。

lines.en: Maya and Sana disappear inside almost immediately, carrying a few bags with their swimsuits and other...girl-related items, I guess.
lines.zh: Maya和Sana几乎立刻就钻了进去，手里提着几个装着泳衣和其他……女生用品的袋子，大概吧。

lines.en: These two seem to have something they want to say to me, though.
lines.zh: 不过这两个人似乎有话要跟我说。

lines.en: : Are you gonna come get changed with us, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei要不要和我们一起换衣服呀？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, I knew you had something to say. I didn’t think it would be that, though.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，我就知道你们有事要说。不过没想到是这个。

lines.en: : She’s kidding, obviously.
lines.zh: : 她当然是开玩笑啦。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo2
: I am?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : You better be...
lines.zh: : 你最好是……

lines.en: : For everyone’s sake, no. I will not be getting changed with you two.
lines.zh: : 为了大家好，不。我不会和你们两个一起换衣服。

lines.en: : Fun fact, I actually don’t even know how to swim.
lines.zh: : 说个好玩的，我其实连游泳都不会。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo3
: What are you talking about? We’ve gone swimming together plenty of times.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我们不是一起游过好多次了吗。

lines.en: : Oh! I know what this is!
lines.zh: : 哦！我知道了！

lines.en: : He’s faking that he doesn’t know how to swim so one of us will volunteer to teach him!
lines.zh: : 他是装作不会游泳，好让我们有人主动提出教他！

lines.en: : I volunteer myself! I’ll have you know I’m a very hands-on teacher, though.
lines.zh: : 我自荐！不过先说好，我可是非常「手把手」的老师哦。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo4
: For the love of God, Ayane! Keep it in your pants!
lines.zh: : 看在上帝的份上，Ayane！你收敛点！

lines.en: : We all know you like him but he’s still my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 我们都知道你喜欢他，可他是我[uncle]！

lines.en: : And if you even think of spending this entire weekend harassing him, I swear on all that is holy that I will end you.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢整个周末都缠着他，我对天发誓，我会把你了结了。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Ami’s mad.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。Ami生气了。

lines.en: : Quick, let's jump into the water to avoid her wrath.
lines.zh: : 快，跳进水里躲她的怒火。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo5
: You’re not helping!
lines.zh: : 你别添乱！

lines.en: : Now now, children. Simmer down. I promise to keep it in my pants.
lines.zh: : 好了好了，孩子们。消消气。我保证会收敛。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo6
: I might be in love but even I know it’s unreasonable to keep him all to myself for an entire weekend.
lines.zh: : 我也许是坠入爱河了，但我也知道，整个周末把他占为己有是不讲道理的。

lines.en: : We’re all here to have fun. And even if I’m the one paying for the whole thing, Sensei is the one kind enough to chaperone all of us.
lines.zh: : 我们都是来玩的。而且就算整趟行程都是我出的钱，愿意陪我们大家来的也是Sensei。

lines.en: : Who would I be to hog all the teacher-time?
lines.zh: : 我哪能把「老师时间」全占了？

lines.en: : Please do not refer to the time we spend together as teacher-time. That makes it sound kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 拜托别把我们共处的时间叫「老师时间」。听着怪恶心的。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo7
: Teacher-time.
lines.zh: : 老师时间。

lines.en: : Why do I suddenly feel like this weekend might not be as relaxing as I originally thought?
lines.zh: : 我怎么突然觉得这个周末可能没有我原本想的那么轻松？

lines.en: Gee, I don’t know, Ami. You’re the one who went and invited the entire class on a trip that I thought was going to be for the two of us.
lines.zh: 天晓得，Ami。明明我以为只有我们两个人的旅行，是你自己跑去把全班都邀请上了。

lines.en: Though, Ayane coming definitely saved me a lot of money.
lines.zh: 不过Ayane来了确实替我省了一大笔钱。

lines.en: And Makoto is the one who wound up booking the place.
lines.zh: 而且订地方的是Makoto。

lines.en: So what may be an exhausting weekend for Ami is more like tropical, ecchi paradise for me.
lines.zh: 所以对Ami来说或许是个累人的周末，对我来说却更像热带色情天堂。

lines.en: Let’s get this show on the road and see some swimsuits.
lines.zh: 好戏开场，我们去看泳衣吧。

lines.en: : Okay, well, you two do your thing and go take each other’s clothes off. I’m gonna go look around for the other girls.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你们两个去忙，把彼此的衣服脱了吧。我去转转找找其他女生。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo8
: Why on Earth would you word it like that?...
lines.zh: : 你干嘛非要用这种说法？……

lines.en: : Come on, Ami! Let’s go take each other’s clothes off like your [uncle] asked!
lines.zh: : 走吧，Ami！按你[uncle]说的，我们去把彼此的衣服脱了！

lines.en: scene beachvactwo9
: Hah...whatever. We’ll go get changed.
lines.zh: : 哈……算了。我们去换衣服。

lines.en: : I’m taking my own clothes off, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我自己脱自己的。

lines.en: : But then who will undress me?
lines.zh: : 那谁来帮我脱？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo10
Ami and Ayane disappear into the bathroom and I can hear my [niece] begin to yell something unintelligible almost immediately.
lines.zh: Ami和Ayane消失在洗手间里，我几乎立刻就听到我的[niece]开始喊着什么听不清的话。

lines.en: scene black
I circle around the restroom to see if I spot anyone else I know and find the beach surprisingly empty.
lines.zh: 我绕到洗手间另一侧，看能不能认出别的熟人，却发现海滩空得出奇。

lines.en: It’s a Saturday in the middle of Summer, so why the hell isn’t anyone around?
lines.zh: 现在是盛夏的周六，怎么一个人都没有？

lines.en: I kick up some sand as I continue to walk down the beach before finally spotting a pair of familiar faces.
lines.zh: 我踢着沙子继续沿海滩走，终于看见了两张熟悉的脸。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo11
: Glad to see you’ve made it this far into the next dimension, Supreme Overlord.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到您平安抵达异次元，至高霸主。

lines.en: : Translation: Hi, Sensei! I’m glad you made it here safely.
lines.zh: : 翻译：Sensei好！我很高兴你安全到了。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin. Would you mind tagging along for every conversation I have with Molly from now on?
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Rin。以后我和Molly的每场对话，你都愿意陪着当翻译吗？

lines.en: : I’ll pay you if I have to.
lines.zh: : 要的话我付钱也行。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo12
: How much we talkin’ here? I make pretty good tips at the cafe so it will have to be a lot.
lines.zh: : 你说多少？我在咖啡馆小费赚得挺多的，所以得是很大一笔才行。

lines.en: : You make tips at the cafe?
lines.zh: : 你在咖啡馆能拿到小费？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo13
: You probably would too if you stopped trying to recruit every single customer into your guild.
lines.zh: : 你要不是非要把每个客人都招进你的公会，大概也能拿到。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo14
: We need a paladin! What else am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 我们需要圣骑士！你让我怎么办？

lines.en: : I posted a whole thing on Reddit and didn’t even get a frickin’ upvote! You know how much that sucks when you type out a 2,000 word guild description?!
lines.zh: : 我在 Reddit 上发了整篇帖子，连他妈一个赞都没收到！你知道辛辛苦苦敲了两千字公会简介却没人理有多难受吗？！

lines.en: scene beachvactwo15
: Translation: No one on the Internet wants to join my stupid guild.
lines.zh: : 翻译：网上没人想加入我那个蠢公会。

lines.en: : You’ll burn for this, witch.
lines.zh: : 你会为此付出代价的，女巫。

lines.en: : Did you two come here together or something?
lines.zh: : 你们两个是一起来的吗？

lines.en: : I know me and some of the others are kind of late, so sorry if we kept you waiting long.
lines.zh: : 我知道我和另外几个人来晚了，要是让你们等太久的话抱歉。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo16
: It’s no biggie, dude. Molly and I came way early so we kind of expected no one else to be here.
lines.zh: : 没事啦，哥们。我和Molly来得太早了，本来就料到没别的人。

lines.en: : It’s not often that Haruka gives us the weekend off, so I think it’s safe to say the two of us wanted to make the best possible use of that time.
lines.zh: : 遥难得放我们周末假，所以我想说，我们俩就是想把这段时间利用到极致。

lines.en: : Right-o! And also, neither of us slept last night because we were playing some new game together.
lines.zh: : 没错！而且我们俩昨晚为了一起玩新出的游戏，压根没睡。

lines.en: : You didn’t sleep? Like, at all?
lines.zh: : 你们没睡？一点都没？

lines.en: : Not a wink.
lines.zh: : 一眼都没合。

lines.en: : Who needs sleep when you can just keep caffeinating until your body shuts down all on its own?
lines.zh: : 只要不停摄入咖啡因，直到身体自己关机就好了，谁还需要睡觉？

lines.en: : Normal people.
lines.zh: : 正常人会。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo17
: I gave up on being normal a long, long time ago.
lines.zh: : 我很久很久以前就放弃当正常人了。

lines.en: : This is the life I have chosen and you must respect it if you ever want to try one of my drinks again.
lines.zh: : 这是我选择的人生，你要是还想再喝我调的酒，就得尊重它。

lines.en: : I mean, I’d be more than happy to consume a drink I actually order for once.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我更想喝一次我真正点的饮料。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo18
: Guh! My womanly heart!
lines.zh: : 咕！我的少女心！

lines.en: : Ya know, Sir, I’m always willing to make you a drink that I-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，大人，我随时愿意为你调一杯——

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不用。

lines.en: : You must not have heard me. What I’m trying to say is-
lines.zh: : 你一定没听清。我想说的是——

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不用。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo19
: Why do you betray me when I need you most?!
lines.zh: : 为什么在我最需要你的时候背叛我？！

lines.en: : What are you even doing exposing yourself to sunlight like this, Molly? Aren’t you afraid of getting sunburnt or whatever it is you were worried about the other day?
lines.zh: : Molly，你跑来晒什么太阳啊？前两天你不是还担心晒伤之类的吗？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo20
: I would have been if it weren’t for the draught of protection.
lines.zh: : 要不是有防护药剂，我确实会晒伤。

lines.en: : Translation: I’m wearing sunscreen.
lines.zh: : 翻译：我涂了防晒霜。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Rin。

lines.en: : No prob. I’ll send you an invoice later.
lines.zh: : 不客气。回头给你寄账单。

lines.en: : Appreciated.
lines.zh: : 感激不尽。

lines.en: : Do you require a draught as well, Sir? I’d be more than happy to help apply it for you.
lines.zh: : 大人您也需要药剂吗？我很乐意帮您涂。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo21
: Dude! What the Hell?! You can’t just ask to rub down our teacher like that. Even if he is cool with it.
lines.zh: : 姐妹！搞什么鬼？！你不能就这么开口说要给我们的老师做全身按摩啊。就算他本人乐意。

lines.en: : I should probably be offended that you assume I'm cool with that, but I’m honestly just glad you understand me, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你默认我乐意，我大概该觉得被冒犯，不过说真的，我挺高兴你这么懂我，Rin。

lines.en: : Well, what if both of us were to do it, then? You’ve got a lot of body and my tiny Irish arms wouldn’t be able to reach the whole thing without some help from a friend.
lines.zh: : 那要是我们两个一起涂呢？您的身子那么大，我这小小的爱尔兰胳膊没朋友帮忙可够不着。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo22
: Translation: I’m a pervert currently battling sexual frustration since I didn’t get to rub one out last night.
lines.zh: : 翻译：我是个变态，昨晚没能自己解决，正在和性欲作斗争。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo23
: AHHH! RIN!
lines.zh: : 啊！！Rin！

lines.en: : AT LEAST USE CODE WORDS OR SOMETHING!
lines.zh: : 至少也用个暗号什么的啊！

lines.en: scene black
Molly suddenly runs away and Rin follows after her, leaving me with a quick wink.
lines.zh: Molly突然跑开，Rin朝我飞快地眨了下眼，追了上去。

lines.en: I go back to walking around, but it isn’t long before I run into someone else I know...
lines.zh: 我继续在附近走，可没多久又撞见了另一个熟人……

lines.en: scene beachvactwo24
: I’m ready to party.
lines.zh: : 我准备好开趴了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you are, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你肯定是，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo25
: Ah-
: I like your tube thing. Did you pick it out yourself?
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你那个泳圈。你自己挑的吗？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo24
: It was recommended by my father.
lines.zh: : 是我父亲推荐的。

lines.en: : He recommended you a flotation device?
lines.zh: : 他给你推荐了个漂浮装置？

lines.en: : He recommends me many things.
lines.zh: : 他给我推荐很多东西。

lines.en: : I also do not know how to swim, so there is a good chance this tube will save my life.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不会游泳，所以这个泳圈很有可能救我一命。

lines.en: : It also has a cat on it.
lines.zh: : 上面还有只猫。

lines.en: : Yes, I can see that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我看出来了。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo26
: Meow~
: Did you just meow at me?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚是不是对我喵了一声？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo24
: That was the cat.
lines.zh: : 是那只猫叫的。

lines.en: : I literally watched you do it.
lines.zh: : 我可是亲眼看着你叫的。

lines.en: : You must be mistaken. I would never meow at my teacher.
lines.zh: : 您一定看错了。我绝不会对老师喵喵叫。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo26
: Meow~
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo24
: Okay, that time it was me.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这次是我。

lines.en: It was you the first time as well...
lines.zh: 第一次也是你吧……

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, I’m a little surprised to see you here.
lines.zh: : 我得说，看到你在这儿我有点意外。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Well, I didn’t really think you’d be the type to leave your noodle sanctuary for a weekend of...whatever this is a weekend of.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我真没觉得你是会为了一个……不管这算什么的周末，离开你的面馆圣地的人。

lines.en: : Water, I’m assuming.
lines.zh: : 水，我猜。

lines.en: : Yeah, there’s definitely a lot of that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这里水确实多得是。

lines.en: : I’m here to enjoy my youth.
lines.zh: : 我是来享受青春的。

lines.en: : And also because the Emerald Guardian asked me to come.
lines.zh: : 另外也是因为翡翠守护者让我来的。

lines.en: : Ahh, yeah that makes sense. Molly would have something to do with this.
lines.zh: : 啊，那就说得通了。这事肯定跟Molly有关。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo27
: Did she run off a minute or two ago?
lines.zh: : 她是不是一两分钟前跑掉了？

lines.en: : I could have sworn I heard her yelling strange words I didn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我敢发誓我听到她喊了些我听不懂的怪话。

lines.en: : Yeah. Something about masturbation, I think.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好像是跟自慰有关。

lines.en: : Oh.
scene beachvactwo24
: What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？

lines.en: : Wait, are you being serious?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是认真的？

lines.en: : I’m always serious. Except for when I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很认真。除了不认真的时候。

lines.en: : I honestly can never tell if you’re joking, so you’re gonna have to help me out here.
lines.zh: : 我真分不清你到底在不在开玩笑，你得帮帮我。

lines.en: : Please teach me what masturbation is.
lines.zh: : 请教我什么是自慰。

lines.en: That might be the single most unintentionally erotic thing I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: 这大概是我听过的最无意识地色情的一句话了。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s best if you ask one of the other girls? I don’t think this is something you want to hear from me.
lines.zh: : 你还是去问别的女生比较好吧？我觉得这种事你不会想从我嘴里听到。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo28
: I don’t trust you.
lines.zh: : 我不信你。

lines.en: : You’re going to make me ask them something strange, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是想让我去问她们什么奇怪的东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Who cares even if that's true? You’re all girls.
lines.zh: : 就算是真的又怎么样？你们都是女生。

lines.en: : You might not know this since you’re sheltered but girls talk about stuff like that together all the time.
lines.zh: : 你被保护得太好可能不知道，女生之间经常聊这些的。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好的。

lines.en: : I will tell the other girls that you told me to ask them about masturbation.
lines.zh: : 我会告诉其他女生，是你让我来问她们自慰的事。

lines.en: : No. Definitely leave me out of this. I don’t want to get in trouble.
lines.zh: : 不行。绝对别把我扯进去。我不想惹麻烦。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo29
: It has already been decided.
lines.zh: : 已经决定了。

lines.en: : No, it hasn’t already been decided. Do not, under any circumstances, bring those two things up in the same conversation.
lines.zh: : 不，才没有决定。无论如何都不许把这两件事放在同一句话里说。

lines.en: : Farewell, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 再见了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I need to go party with my bros.
lines.zh: : 我要去找我兄弟们开趴了。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo30
Tsuneyo wanders off toward the water and I am forced to go fit myself into yet another conversation.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo朝水边晃悠过去，我只能硬着头皮又去应付下一场对话。

lines.en: Hopefully the next one turns out a little better than this one did.
lines.zh: 希望下一场能比这场好一点。

lines.en: scene black
scene beachvactwo31
: Welp, there goes that hope.
lines.zh: : 唉，这点希望也没了。

lines.en: : Heh? The fuck you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 哈？你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: : Nothing. What are you up to, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 没什么。你在忙什么，Yumi？

lines.en: : The fuck’s it look like I’m up to, dipshit?
lines.zh: : 我他妈看起来在忙什么，蠢货？

lines.en: : I’m sitting on a table and wondering why I bothered coming here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我坐在桌上，正纳闷自己当初干嘛要来这儿。

lines.en: : If you didn’t want to come, why did you?
lines.zh: : 你要是不想来，为什么还来？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo32
: Fuck if I know. Chika was pretty insistent on me showing up for at least a little bit.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。Chika非让我至少露个面。

lines.en: : No idea why she cares so much about me “socializing” or whatever bullshit she said it was, but I honestly couldn’t care less.
lines.zh: : 她为什么这么在意我「社交」什么的，我也不懂，不过说实话我一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : Where is Chika, by the way? I figured you two would be together.
lines.zh: : 话说Chika在哪儿？我还以为你们俩会在一起。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo33
: Not here.
lines.zh: : 不在这儿。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: I was looking forward to seeing her in her swimsuit again...
lines.zh: 我还盼着再看一次她穿泳衣的样子呢……

lines.en: : She couldn’t get out of work today and wanted to be there for Chinami in the morning.
lines.zh: : 她今天没法请假，而且早上想陪着千奈美。

lines.en: : We’re switching shifts later.
lines.zh: : 我们晚点换班。

lines.en: : She’ll be here tonight and I’ll go hang out with the little twerp and not have to deal with you staring at me all fuckin’ day anymore.
lines.zh: : 她今晚就来，而我也可以去陪那个小屁孩，不用再整天被你他妈盯着了。

lines.en: : We’re having a conversation. Not staring at you for the duration of it would be rude.
lines.zh: : 我们这是在聊天。聊天的时候不看着你才叫失礼吧。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo34
: Oh, please. You borderline stalk me in the streets and now you’re going to try and say the only reason you’re staring at me is because we’re talking?
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你走在街上都快跟踪我了，现在还要说你盯着我的唯一理由是我们正在说话？

lines.en: : I don’t go to[school] much, but I’m not a fuckin' idiot, dude. I can tell when someone is a pervert without having to fuckin’ research ‘em first.
lines.zh: : 我很少去[school]，但我他妈又不傻。谁是变态根本不用先去查。

lines.en: : Well, since you’ve already decided I’m a pervert, mind if I compliment you on how cute you are in your bathing suit?
lines.zh: : 既然你已经认定我是变态了，那我夸一句你穿泳衣很可爱，你介意吗？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo35
: OF FUCKING COURSE I MIND!
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然介意！

lines.en: : That’s literally the one thing I didn’t want to fucking hear!
lines.zh: : 这可是我最不想听到的一句话！

lines.en: : Fuck, dude! If it wasn’t so god damn hot I’d be wearing my normal clothes anyway!
lines.zh: : 操，靠！要不是热得要死，我早就穿平时的衣服了！

lines.en: : Those normal clothes really don’t do you any favors, though. They’re too baggy.
lines.zh: : 不过你平时那身衣服真的不衬你。太宽松了。

lines.en: : Things like this fit you much better.
lines.zh: : 这种衣服适合你多了。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo36
: Bullshit. You’re only saying that because the less clothes a girl is wearing, the more attractive you think they are.
lines.zh: : 放屁。你只是觉得女生穿得越少越好看。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许是。

lines.en: : But you really do look cute. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 但你真的很可爱。我是认真的。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo37
: Eat shit and die.
lines.zh: : 去吃屎然后死掉吧。

lines.en: Yumi and I engage in a staredown for several seconds but it feels more like hours.
lines.zh: 我和Yumi对视了几秒，却感觉像过了好几个小时。

lines.en: The staredown is immediately halted when someone else shows up, though...
lines.zh: 不过，这僵持很快被另一个人的出现打断了……

lines.en: scene beachvactwo38
: Umm...hey. Sorry I’m late.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗨。抱歉我迟到了。

lines.en: : I had some stuff to take care of at the library first.
lines.zh: : 我得先在图书馆处理点事。

lines.en: : Oh shit. Didn’t think I’d ever see a beached whale in person.
lines.zh: : 哦操。没想到我还能亲眼见到搁浅的鲸鱼。

lines.en: : Do we gotta call the Coast Guard or some shit? How does this work?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要叫海岸警卫队什么的？这流程怎么走？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo39
: Don’t listen to her, Futaba. Yumi is in a bad mood today.
lines.zh: : 别听她的，二叶。Yumi今天心情不好。

lines.en: : I...can see that.
lines.zh: : 我……看得出来。

lines.en: : And no worries about being late. I was late too.
lines.zh: : 迟到也别放心上。我也迟到了。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo40
: Were you? How come?
lines.zh: : 是吗？为什么？

lines.en: : I may or may not have overslept. But that doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 我可能睡过头了。不过这不重要。

lines.en: : What does matter is that we’re both here now. And we’re going to have as good a weekend as we possibly can.
lines.zh: : 重要的是我们现在都在这儿了。我们要把这个周末过得尽可能开心。

lines.en: : Oh golly gee. That sounds so swell.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪天哪。听起来真棒啊。

lines.en: : Just keep ignoring her and she’ll fade away.
lines.zh: : 一直别理她，她就会自己消失的。

lines.en: : I fucking wish.
lines.zh: : 我他妈也希望啊。

lines.en: : Mhm. I’ll...do my best.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我……尽量吧。

lines.en: : I like your hair like that, by the way. It looks nice.
lines.zh: : 对了，我喜欢你这样扎头发。很好看。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo41
: R-Really?!
lines.zh: : 真……真的吗？！

lines.en: : I didn’t really do it on purpose or anything. I just figured that since we’re gonna be swimming and whatnot...
lines.zh: : 我也不是故意弄成这样的。只是想着我们要游泳什么的……

lines.en: : Well, I’m sure you can figure out the rest.
lines.zh: : 剩下的你应该能猜到。

lines.en: : I’m sure I can as well.
lines.zh: : 我猜我也猜到了。

lines.en: : You’re not planning on swimming in your casual clothes, though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过你总不打算穿着便装下水吧？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo42
: Of course not...I was about to go change but just...wanted to say hi first.
lines.zh: : 当然不会……我正准备去换，只是……想先打个招呼。

lines.en: : Sure seems like a long hello.
lines.zh: : 这招呼打的时间可真长。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: Okay, well...I’m gonna go get changed.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那……我去换衣服了。

lines.en: : Don’t expect too much, though. I wasn’t really able to find anything good when I went shopping the other day so I kind of just...got the first thing I saw.
lines.zh: : 不过别期待太高。我前两天去买的时候没挑到什么好的，就……拿了第一件看到的。

lines.en: : More like nothing would fit so you-
lines.zh: : 倒不如说是什么都穿不下所以你——

lines.en: scene beachvactwo43
: Yumi. Please just stop talking.
lines.zh: : Yumi。请你闭嘴。

lines.en: : I think...you look really pretty, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你很好看，Yumi。

lines.en: : I’ll be back in a few minutes...
lines.zh: : 我几分钟后就回来……

lines.en: scene beachvactwo44
Futaba picks her bag up off the ground and quietly moves over to the restroom.
lines.zh: 二叶从地上拎起包，安静地走向洗手间。

lines.en: Yumi remains silent and focuses on the sand, hopefully reflecting on how much of an asshole she is.
lines.zh: Yumi一言不发，盯着沙子看，但愿是在反省自己有多混蛋。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo45
: The fuck is your problem?
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么毛病？

lines.en: : What, you’re just not going to respond now?
lines.zh: : 怎么，现在不打算回话了？

lines.en: : No point.
lines.zh: : 没意义。

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ follow her.
lines.zh: : 你他妈去追她啊。

lines.en: : Not like talkin’ to me is worth anything anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正跟我说话也没什么价值。

lines.en: scene sky
I do as Yumi says and begin to walk back toward the restroom to make sure Futaba is okay.
lines.zh: 我照Yumi说的做，转身往洗手间走，去确认二叶没事。

lines.en: I’m sure she doesn’t actually care about Futaba’s feelings, but I do. So I need to make sure she doesn’t take Yumi’s words to heart.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她其实并不在乎二叶的感受，但我在乎。所以我得确保她没把Yumi的话放在心上。

lines.en: I’m sure it’s hard enough for someone with low confidence to put on a bathing suit in public, so Futaba is already being brave.
lines.zh: 对一个缺乏自信的人来说，在公共场合穿上泳衣本来就够难的了，二叶已经很勇敢了。

lines.en: Having one more obstacle in the way between her and feeling comfortable just isn’t fair.
lines.zh: 再在她和自在之间多设一道障碍，就太不公平了。

lines.en: Once she finishes changing, I wave her over and pull her around the back of the restroom.
lines.zh: 等她换好，我朝她招手，把她带到洗手间后面。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo46
: Umm...did you need something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你找我有什么事吗？

lines.en: : It feels a little weird being alone back here when everyone is right around the corner.
lines.zh: : 大家就在拐角那边，我却一个人被带到后面来，感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : I just wanted to make sure you were doing okay.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确认你还好。

lines.en: : Yumi can be a bitch sometimes and you shouldn’t take what she says to heart.
lines.zh: : Yumi有时候就是个贱人，她说的话你别往心里去。

lines.en: : I know that. You tell me all the time.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你一直都这么跟我说。

lines.en: : And besides, I’m fine. Really.
lines.zh: : 而且我真的没事。真的。

lines.en: : You pulling me aside is enough to put me at ease.
lines.zh: : 你把我拉到一边，这就足够让我安心了。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo47
: I just wish I had something a little more exciting to show you.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望有更刺激一点的东西能给你看。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? You look great.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？你看起来很棒啊。

lines.en: : Oh stop. I’m glad that you’re being nice to me, but this really isn’t a flattering swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。我很高兴你对我这么好，但这件泳衣真的不怎么显好。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo48
: But...hey, at least stripes are slimming, right?
lines.zh: : 不过……嘿，至少条纹显瘦，对吧？

lines.en: I’m not really sure what to say to that.
lines.zh: 我真不知道该怎么接。

lines.en: On one hand, it seems like Futaba is finally learning to laugh about herself...But at the same time, it’s a slightly off-putting self degradation.
lines.zh: 一方面，二叶似乎终于学会自嘲了……但另一方面，这种自我贬低又让人有点不舒服。

lines.en: But I guess in times like these, it’s best to follow your heart.
lines.zh: 不过这种时候，还是跟着心走最好。

lines.en: I’m sure that’s what Futaba would want me to do.
lines.zh: 我相信二叶也会希望我这么做。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. Can I make a request?
lines.zh: : 嘿，二叶。我能提个请求吗？

lines.en: : Depends. What do you wa-
lines.zh: : 看情况。你想要什——

lines.en: : Can you show me your boobs?
lines.zh: : 能让我看看你的胸吗？

lines.en: scene beachvactwo49
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Sorry. I told myself to follow my heart and that's just the first thing that came out.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我跟自己说要跟着心走，结果脱口而出的就是这个。

lines.en: : Why am I not surprised by this?
lines.zh: : 我怎么一点都不意外呢？

lines.en: : Come on. Just for a second.
lines.zh: : 来嘛。就看一眼。

lines.en: : You can’t wear a skin-tight bathing suit like that and expect me to not want to see them.
lines.zh: : 你穿着那么贴身的泳衣，总不能指望我不想看吧。

lines.en: : And besides, the two of us are totally alone back here. No one is going to see.
lines.zh: : 再说这里只有我们两个，没人会看见。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo50
: I don’t know, [futabamaster]...It seems like a pretty bad idea to me...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，[futabamaster]……我觉得这主意挺糟的……

lines.en: : Just for a second. Come on.
lines.zh: : 就看一眼。来嘛。

lines.en: : You know you want to.
lines.zh: : 你自己也想的对吧。

lines.en: : Mmn...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: scene beachvactwo51
: Is this much okay?...
lines.zh: : 这样够了吗？……

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’m really confident enough to pull my suit down.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定自己有没有自信把泳衣拉下来。

lines.en: : These things are kind of hard to put back inside on short notice and I don’t want to get caught.
lines.zh: : 这东西一时半会儿很难再塞回去，我不想被抓到。

lines.en: : Hmm...
if futaba_lust < 10:
: Yeah...I guess that much is fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧……这样也行吧。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo46
: Good...I’m glad I was able to make you happy. Even if it was only just a little.
lines.zh: : 太好了……能让你开心我就高兴了。哪怕只有一点点。

lines.en: : Of course. I’m always happy to see-
lines.zh: : 当然。我总是很高兴看——

lines.en: else:
: I think I’m going to need a little more than that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还需要再多看一点。

lines.en: : Yeah...I figured as much.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我就知道。

lines.en: : You need to tell me if someone is coming, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是有人过来，你得告诉我。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Then...
scene beachvactwo52
Futaba slides down the top half of her bathing suit and reveals her two massive breasts, holding them up to make them look better for me.
lines.zh: 二叶把泳衣上半身褪下，露出两团硕大的乳房，还托起来好让我看得更清楚。

lines.en: : Um...are you happy now?
lines.zh: : 嗯……现在满意了吗？

lines.en: : Not yet. I need another minute or two to take in the beauty.
lines.zh: : 还没有。我还需要一两分钟好好欣赏这美景。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo53
: Okay, but hurry it up because they sunburn pretty easily.
lines.zh: : 可以，但你快点，它们很容易晒伤。

lines.en: : How do you know that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : I just know, okay? It doesn’t matter how.
lines.zh: : 我就是知道，行吧？别管怎么知道的。

lines.en: : Well hey, if they do get sunburnt, it will have been worth it.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，就算晒伤了，也值了。

lines.en: : For you, yes. But not for me.
lines.zh: : 对你值，对我可不值。

lines.en: : My pain tolerance is pretty much non-existent. In fact, I’m already starting to feel the heat.
lines.zh: : 我几乎完全受不了疼。事实上，我已经开始觉得热了。

lines.en: : Just a few more minutes and-
lines.zh: : 再等几分钟就——

lines.en: scene beachvactwo48
: Nope. All done~
lines.zh: : 不行。到此为止~

lines.en: : Damn it. I’m supposed to be in charge here.
lines.zh: : 可恶。明明该是我说了算的。

lines.en: : You can be in charge some other time. I’m here to have fun with my friends, not make my teacher's penis hard.
lines.zh: : 别的什么时候让你说了算吧。我是来和朋友玩的，不是来让老师的鸡巴硬起来的。

lines.en: : This is not the vacation I signed up for.
lines.zh: : 这可不是我报名参加的度假。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo54
A whistle suddenly rings out from not far behind the restroom pavilion.
lines.zh: 洗手间凉亭后不远处突然响起一声哨声。

lines.en: I panic for a brief moment thinking that maybe a lifeguard or someone caught us, but that panic is quelled when I hear who shouts after the whistle.
lines.zh: 我慌了一瞬，以为是被救生员还是谁抓到了，不过等听到哨声后喊话的人，这份慌乱就平息了。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come out from wherever you’re hiding! Vacation hasn’t started just yet!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你躲哪儿去了快出来！假期还没正式开始呢！

lines.en: scene beachvactwo55
: Did you have plans with Makoto this morning?
lines.zh: : 你今天早上和Makoto有约吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so? Why does it sound like I’m in trouble?
lines.zh: : 我不记得有啊？怎么听起来像我闯祸了？

lines.en: : I have no idea. You'd better go, though. She gets kind of evil when things don’t go her way.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不过你最好过去一趟。事情不顺她意的时候，她会变得挺可怕的。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I know.
lines.zh: : 是是是。我知道。

lines.en: : I’m going.
lines.zh: : 我这就去。

lines.en: scene sky
I step away from Futaba for a moment and put my hands in the air as if I’m under arrest.
lines.zh: 我从二叶身边走开片刻，双手举过头顶，像是在被逮捕。

lines.en: I’m not exactly sure what Makoto wants from me, but judging by the tone of her voice, she doesn’t seem too happy about it...
lines.zh: 我不太确定Makoto要我做什么，不过听她的语气，她似乎对此很不高兴……

lines.en: scene beachvactwo56
: There you are...I’ve been looking all over for you.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿啊……我到处找你。

lines.en: : Why do you look like you’re up to no good?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一副在干坏事的样子？

lines.en: : Yeah, why are yer’ hands up in the air like yer’ gettin’ arrested?
lines.zh: : 对啊，你干嘛把手举得像是要被抓似的？

lines.en: : You didn’t do somethin’ weird behind the bathrooms, did ya? I coulda sworn I saw someone else back there.
lines.zh: : 你没在洗手间后面搞什么奇怪的事吧？我敢发誓我看到那边还有别人。

lines.en: : Nope. Just me.
lines.zh: : 没有。就我一个。

lines.en: : I’ll put my hands down now.
lines.zh: : 我现在把手放下来了。

lines.en: : Yeah...thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢了。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo57
: Anyway, I need you to come with me for a bit.
lines.zh: : 总之，你跟我来一趟。

lines.en: : Why? What did I do wrong?
lines.zh: : 为什么？我做错什么了？

lines.en: : We’re late for check-in at the inn. I put it under my name but I still need you to be there with me.
lines.zh: : 旅馆入住我们要迟到了。我订的时候写的是我的名字，但办理入住还是得你和我一起。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That’s a thing we’re doing.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。是有这回事。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo58
: It’s literally half of this vacation.
lines.zh: : 这可是这趟假期的一半啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. I just got swept up in all the bathing suits and forgot about it.
lines.zh: : 是，我知道。我只是被满眼的泳衣冲昏了头，给忘了。

lines.en: : I don’t blame ya! Lots of cute girls runnin’ around these parts with their butts all bouncin’ about and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我不怪你！这一带好多可爱姑娘跑来跑去，屁股一颠一颠的什么的。

lines.en: : Crazy times, Sensei. Crazy times.
lines.zh: : 疯狂的时代啊，Sensei。疯狂的时代。

lines.en: : Crazy times or not, I need you to stop staring at all of these “bouncing butts” as Miku put it for a few moments and follow me to the inn.
lines.zh: : 不管时代疯不疯，我需要你别再盯着Miku说的那些「一颠一颠的屁股」了，先跟我去旅馆。

lines.en: : It’s not a far walk from here. Maybe only ten minutes or so. But we should be back around noon-ish.
lines.zh: : 离这儿不远。大概也就十分钟。不过我们应该中午左右就回来。

lines.en: : Ugh, fine. If I have to.
lines.zh: : 唉，好吧。既然非去不可。

lines.en: : But just know that I’m not happy about missing out on the butts.
lines.zh: : 但你要知道，错过了这些屁股我可不开心。

lines.en: : I knew you wouldn’t be.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会不开心。

lines.en: scene beachvactwo59
: Don’t worry, Sensei! Good ole’ Miku will let you look at hers when ya get back! Even if it’s as flat as a board.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sensei！等你回来，好心的Miku愿意让你看她的！虽然平得像块板。

lines.en: : You will do no such thing.
lines.zh: : 你不会做这种事的。

lines.en: : ...Okay, never mind!
lines.zh: : ……好吧，当我没说！

lines.en: : I’ll still see ya later, though!
lines.zh: : 不过回头见啦！

lines.en: scene beachvactwo60
: You don’t mind if I just walk there in this, do you?
lines.zh: : 我就穿这个走过去，你不介意吧？

lines.en: : I don’t want to get dressed again just to go check in and I’m sure they’re used to bathing suits since it’s a beach-inn and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我不想为了去办入住还特意换衣服，而且这里是海滨旅馆，他们应该也习惯客人穿泳衣了。

lines.en: : Why would I ever ask a girl to change out of a bathing suit? Have you forgotten who I am?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会要求一个女生把泳衣换掉？你忘了我是谁了吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately not.
lines.zh: : 可惜没忘。

lines.en: : Let’s head out now before it gets any later, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我们趁还不算太晚赶紧走吧。

lines.en: : Just stick close to me and don’t let any half-naked girls distract you.
lines.zh: : 你就紧跟着我，别被任何半裸的女生勾走魂。

lines.en: : I will do my best...
lines.zh: : 我尽力……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and I begin to walk down the coast together.
lines.zh: 我和Makoto一起沿着海岸往前走。

lines.en: We walk close enough that we occasionally bump arms, but this is entirely her doing.
lines.zh: 我们挨得很近，偶尔会碰到彼此的手臂，但这完全是她的杰作。

lines.en: In fact, I’ve been walking as straight as possible just to confirm that it’s her behind all of this.
lines.zh: 事实上，我特意走得笔直，就是为了确认这一切都是她在搞鬼。

lines.en: It’s not like I mind, though.
lines.zh: 不过我也不介意。

lines.en: We make idle chit-chat all along the shoreline and, before long, wind up in front of an old inn...
lines.zh: 我们一路沿着海岸线闲聊，没多久，就来到了一家老旅馆门前……

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 1
$ beachvacation2 = True
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
lines.zh: 二叶的好感度提升到了[futaba_love]！
